codex.projectrebirth.welcome.p1:
This book follows you through Project: Rebirth: from the first ores and machines to artificial bodies, power armor, factions and survival in a hostile world.

Each tab on the left is a part of the mod. A map shows its entries; a line leads from what you need first to what follows.
codex.projectrebirth.welcome.p2: Every player gets the Codex once, on first entering the world. A lost one is made again on a crafting table.
codex.projectrebirth.welcome.p3: Click a medallion to open its entry. Arrows, the mouse wheel or A and D turn the pages; right-click, Escape or the red button return to the map. Hover over an item to see its name.
codex.projectrebirth.welcome.p4: A book and an iron ingot.
codex.projectrebirth.path.p1:
The mod grows as a chain: every new station and every body needs what the previous ones made.

1. Mine the new ores: tin, aluminum, silver, lithium, titanium. Copper and tin make bronze.
2. The electronics fabricator (crafting table) makes circuit boards, processors and power cells.
3. The assembly station makes actuators, synthetic fiber, the transfer capsule and the first artificial bodies.
codex.projectrebirth.path.p2:
4. The armor workstation makes armor plates and the parts of power armor; then come the implant fabricator, the armor upgrade fabricator and the weapon workshop.
5. Stations need energy: a combustion generator, solar panels, a battery, cable.
6. The world is hostile from the first day: a respirator, filters and a roof at first, a sealed shelter with air filtration later.
codex.projectrebirth.path.p3: 7. Catastrophes leave contaminated land and ruins full of loot, machines and mutants. Before an expedition, learn the way: a weather station foresees the next catastrophe, a monitoring station maps the contamination around and prints it on paper, and in the field the analyzer, the sensor module of a body or the sensor unit of armor show what is near. Clean water comes from the water purifier.
codex.projectrebirth.path.p4:
8. Multiblocks: big machines built of blocks. The body workshop assembles synthetic bodies and androids, the heavy dock power armor, turrets and the mech.

9. The Garrison: an AI core (electronics fabricator) puts a machine to work for you. First a combat or work android on a simple body and a command console with a tactical tablet; then small robots and defence turrets around the shelter and a service post; at the top the guard mech.
codex.projectrebirth.path.p5: Each tab of this book is one branch of that chain.
codex.projectrebirth.keys.p1:
Keys of the mod (change them in Controls, section "Project: Rebirth"):

Z — return to the human body
V (hold) — emergency release of the hatch of a shut-down armor
9 in armor — the ability slot
B — worker armor: mine 3×3 or one block
N — floodlight of the armor
R — reload a weapon
G — the faction window
H — HUD and transfer animation settings
codex.projectrebirth.keys.p2:
H opens the HUD settings: turn it on or off, its size and where the panels stand, the transfer animation, and the HUD of the garrison: bars over your machines, the console alarm mark, the tablet lines. They are kept for each player.

The balance of the mod is in config/projectrebirth-server.toml.
codex.projectrebirth.ores.p1:
Five new ores lie in the world, in stone and in deepslate:

Tin — common, from y −16 to 112.
Aluminum — common, from 0 to 112.
Silver — from −64 to 32.
Lithium — rare, from −48 to 16.
Titanium — the rarest and deepest, from −80 to 0.

Mined ore gives raw metal; a furnace or a blast furnace makes ingots of it.
codex.projectrebirth.ores.p2: Tin ore: needed for bronze from the very start.
codex.projectrebirth.ores.p3: Deepslate titanium ore: for the armor workstation, armor and the best bodies.
codex.projectrebirth.ores.p4: A blast furnace smelts raw metal twice as fast.
codex.projectrebirth.ores.p5: A sixth, radioactive ore, uranium, lies even deeper: see the entry Uranium in the Hostile Environment tab.
codex.projectrebirth.bronze.p1: Three copper ingots and one tin ingot give four of bronze.
codex.projectrebirth.bronze.p2: Bronze goes into the electronics fabricator itself and into actuators — the motors of bodies, armor and machines.
codex.projectrebirth.stations.p1: Every production station works the same way. In its window pick a recipe from the list; put the materials into the six slots (the needed amounts are shown); the station makes the result by itself and goes on while there are materials and room in the output slot.
codex.projectrebirth.stations.p2:
A station uses 20 FE of energy per tick while it works and holds 20 000 FE. Without energy it waits and keeps the progress made so far.

Hoppers and pipes of other mods put materials in and take the results out. With JEI installed, all station recipes are in it.
codex.projectrebirth.stations.p3: A server may let stations work without energy: [energy] stationsNeedEnergy = false.
codex.projectrebirth.electronics_fabrica: The first station: circuit boards, processors, power cells and the dosimeter.
Made on a crafting table from iron, glass, bronze and redstone.
Circuit boards: copper, silver and redstone. They are in almost everything.
Processors, for advanced bodies and machines: boards, silver, quartz and gold.
Power cells: lithium, aluminum, copper and redstone. They store energy in bodies, armor and batteries.
codex.projectrebirth.assembly_station.p1: Actuators, synthetic fiber, the transfer capsule, robot bodies, the heavy actuator and the manipulators. Synthetic bodies are assembled in the body workshop (Garrison tab).
codex.projectrebirth.assembly_station.p2: Aluminum, circuit boards, a crafting table and iron.
codex.projectrebirth.assembly_station.p4: Synthetic fiber, the skin of synthetic bodies: string and a slime ball.
codex.projectrebirth.armor_workstation.p: Armor plates, the heavy protective suit and the parts of power armor: the power frame and the hulls of three kinds. The armor itself is assembled in the heavy dock (Garrison tab).
Titanium, actuators, an anvil and iron.
Armor plates: the shell of power armor and a part of later stations.
Gadgets for artificial bodies: armor plates of copper, iron or titanium, the sealing module, the jetpack.
Iron, a circuit board, actuators and a smithing table.
More in the tab of bodies.
codex.projectrebirth.armor_upgrade_fabri: Upgrades of power armor: plating of copper, iron or titanium, the compressed air module, the floodlight.
Iron, an armor plate, actuators and a smithing table.
They are put on with the mounting tool, made on a crafting table. More in the tab of armor.
codex.projectrebirth.weapon_workshop.p1: Guns of power armor and their rounds: two rifles and a combat shotgun.
codex.projectrebirth.weapon_workshop.p2: Iron, an armor plate, circuit boards and a smithing table.
codex.projectrebirth.weapon_workshop.p3: More in the tab of armor.
codex.projectrebirth.maintenance_station: Repairs packed armor and bodies. The critical integrity of armor is mended only here.
Iron, an actuator, circuit boards and an anvil.

Put the packed armor or body in and add the materials: every two seconds the station uses one of them and 20 FE per tick.

Armor: armor plates mend the critical integrity, iron ingots the structural one, up to the maximum with the plating of its upgrades. Robot bodies take iron ingots, synthetic bodies synthetic fiber. Since 1.5 the station also takes wear off bodies: actuators for robots, circuit boards for synthetics.
codex.projectrebirth.energy_basics.p1:
Machines of the mod run on energy in FE (NeoForge Energy); it works with the machines and cables of other mods.

Stations use 20 FE per tick while they work; the air filtration unit, the decontamination chamber and the purge station use their own amounts. Every machine keeps a store of its own.
codex.projectrebirth.energy_basics.p2: A generator gives energy to the blocks right next to it and into cables; the cable carries it to everything joined to it.
codex.projectrebirth.combustion_generato: Burns anything a furnace burns, for as long as a furnace would, and makes 40 FE per tick meanwhile.
Iron, a furnace, copper and redstone — the first energy of the game.
It stops burning while its store is full, so no fuel is wasted, and gives up to 200 FE per tick to its neighbours and cables. A hopper can bring fuel; an empty bucket after lava comes out.
codex.projectrebirth.solar_panel.p1: 8 FE per tick in daylight under the open sky; nothing at night and in rain, a quarter in a dust storm.
codex.projectrebirth.solar_panel.p2: Glass, aluminum, a circuit board and iron.
codex.projectrebirth.solar_panel.p3: A panel gives energy only downwards: put the cable or the machine under it. It is placed like stairs, its high edge away from you.
codex.projectrebirth.radioisotope_genera: Makes 24 FE per tick all the time, with no fuel and in any weather; holds 40 000 FE. It gives energy to its neighbours and cables, and a comparator reads its charge.
Titanium, uranium, processors and a power cell: a late machine.
It radiates around itself, 3 units next to it and up to 6 blocks. Put it behind walls, away from where you live and work: each solid block halves it.
codex.projectrebirth.cable.p1: Joins generators, batteries and machines, of this mod and of others. A cable network can be up to 4096 cables long.
codex.projectrebirth.cable.p3:
Energy put into a cable goes to every machine on it that takes energy: an equal share each, then what is left in turn.

Since 1.4.0 life support comes first: while the air filtration unit and the other life support blocks are short, production stations on the same cable wait. The cable also passes through the wall of a sealed room without letting the air out.
codex.projectrebirth.battery.p1: Stores 500 000 FE. It takes energy on every side and gives it only through its front, marked with an arrow.
codex.projectrebirth.battery.p2: Lithium, redstone, a power cell and iron.
codex.projectrebirth.battery.p3: Put it between generators and the machines, front towards the machines: it never sends energy back the way it came. Up to 1000 FE per tick in and out. A comparator reads its charge; its screen glows while the charge changes.
codex.projectrebirth.consciousness.p1: Your mind can leave the human body and live in an artificial one. The human body stays behind in the transfer capsule; there it is safe from hunger but not from attack.
codex.projectrebirth.consciousness.p2: The transfer capsule, two blocks high, made at the assembly station.
codex.projectrebirth.consciousness.p4:
Place a body from its item. Right-click the capsule: it lists all your bodies — class, integrity, distance, state — with a button "Transfer". A body must stand within 16 blocks of the capsule.

Z returns you to the human body. If the artificial body is destroyed, the mind comes back by itself; without a human body it goes to a spare body, and with no bodies left an ordinary death follows.
codex.projectrebirth.consciousness.p5: Bodies and their inventories survive leaving the game and a server restart.
codex.projectrebirth.basic_robot_body.p1: Class 1, robotic. Integrity 20, armor 2, speed ×0.85. One gadget slot.
codex.projectrebirth.basic_robot_body.p2: The first body, made at the assembly station.
codex.projectrebirth.improved_robot_body: Class 2, robotic. Integrity 26, armor 4, speed ×0.95, damage +0.5. Two gadget slots.
A better body is made from the one before it; its gadgets go over to the new one.
codex.projectrebirth.advanced_synthetic_: Class 3, synthetic. Integrity 30, armor 6, speed ×1.0, damage +1. Mends itself slowly. Three slots.
codex.projectrebirth.hightech_synthetic_: Class 4, synthetic. Integrity 36, armor 8, speed ×1.1, damage +2. Four slots.
Titanium, processors and a power cell.
codex.projectrebirth.premium_synthetic_b: Class 5, synthetic. Integrity 40, armor 10, speed ×1.2, damage +3, the fastest self-repair. Five slots.
The best body of the mod: it also needs netherite and an echo shard. It is the only one that eats golden apples and drinks potions, and the only one they work on.
codex.projectrebirth.body_life.p1:
Instead of hearts a body has an integrity bar; it has no hunger. Bodies of classes 1–4 neither eat nor drink, and potions do not work on them. No machine feels potions either.

Bodies do not wear ordinary armor, elytra, pumpkins or heads. Their inventory is their own: in place of armor slots it has a panel with the class, integrity and gadget slots.
codex.projectrebirth.body_life.p2:
Synthetic bodies (classes 3–5) mend themselves a few seconds after damage, while they have charge; it costs charge.

An empty body stands like a solid thing: you can stand on it and nothing pushes it away. Since 1.5 every body runs on charge — see Body Charge.
codex.projectrebirth.body_life.p3:
The repair kit mends 35% of integrity in 4 seconds; damage breaks the repair off.

A destroyed body (empty or with you in it) does not vanish: its wreck stays. It cannot be repaired, but the repair wrench with Shift takes it apart for parts.
codex.projectrebirth.body_life.p5: A packed body is mended at the maintenance station: robots with iron, synthetics with synthetic fiber.
codex.projectrebirth.body_modification.p: Puts gadgets into a packed body and takes them out.

Put the packed body in and pick a gadget: installing takes 5 seconds and energy, removing is instant. A body has as many gadget slots as its class — from one to five.

When a body is made into a better one at the assembly station, its gadgets go over; those that do not fit come back as items.
codex.projectrebirth.gadgets.p1:
Gadgets are made at the implant fabricator.

Armor plates add armor: copper +1, iron +2, titanium +3 and +1 toughness, for each plate. Different materials do not mix on one body.
codex.projectrebirth.gadgets.p3: The sealing module keeps the air under water and, since 1.3, keeps acid and dust off the body. It does not save from being stuck in blocks.
codex.projectrebirth.gadgets.p5: The jetpack: hold jump in the air to rise up to 8 blocks above the ground under the body. 6 seconds of thrust, refilled only on the ground; with none left the body falls as usual.
codex.projectrebirth.gadgets.p7: The extra battery adds 40 000 FE to the charge of a body and takes one slot.
codex.projectrebirth.gadgets.p9: The cooling module takes heat away all the time: a body with it overheats much later.
codex.projectrebirth.gadgets.p11: The electronics shielding takes away 90% of the interference of an EMI storm; the recipe is in the entry EMI Storm.
codex.projectrebirth.body_wear.p1: Since 1.5 a body has a second scale beside integrity: wear, from 0 to 100%. Integrity is lost to blows, falls, fire and weapons. Wear is the tiredness of the mechanisms: it grows slowly with work, fast while the body is overheated, and from acid rain, dust and faults in an EMI storm.
codex.projectrebirth.body_wear.p2:
25%: more charge used. 50%: slower, half the self-repair, faster heating. 75%: weaker blows. 100%: critical — half the integrity, much slower, no self-repair.

A worn body is never destroyed by wear and stays under control.
codex.projectrebirth.body_wear.p3: Wear does not mend by itself and not with a repair kit. Pack the body and service it at the maintenance station: actuators take wear off robots, circuit boards off synthetic bodies, 10% each. Better bodies wear more slowly.
codex.projectrebirth.body_wear.p4: An actuator: wear of robot bodies.
codex.projectrebirth.body_wear.p5: A circuit board: wear of synthetic bodies.
codex.projectrebirth.body_heat.p1:
Since 1.5 a body heats up. Running, blows, mining and above all the jetpack heat it, and so do deserts, badlands, the Nether, fire, lava and magma close by.

Rest, shade, rain, cold lands and most of all water cool it. Better bodies cool faster.
codex.projectrebirth.body_heat.p2:
From 70 the body warns. Above 85 it throttles: slower, weaker blows, no jetpack. At 100 it has overheated: it stays throttled and wears fast until it cools below 85.

Overheating never destroys a body and never takes control: lead it into water or shade.
codex.projectrebirth.body_heat.p3: A power armor does not heat up: a body inside one only cools. An empty body standing in the world cools down too.
codex.projectrebirth.body_charge.p1: Since 1.5 every artificial body runs on charge (FE). Walking, running, blows, breaking blocks, self-repair and above all the jetpack spend it. An empty body standing in the world keeps its charge; it goes with the body when you enter it, leave it or pack it.
codex.projectrebirth.body_charge.p2:
A full basic body lasts about a game day of work, the premium one about four.

Below 20% the body warns and slows down. At 0% it is in emergency mode: slow walking, no running, jumping, jetpack or self-repair, slow mining. You keep control; Z always returns you home.
codex.projectrebirth.body_charge.p3: A body standing on the pad, empty or yours, is charged from the cable.
codex.projectrebirth.body_charge.p5: Hold right-click in a body: in 3 seconds it hands over its charge. Damage breaks it off.
codex.projectrebirth.body_charge.p7: Charge the body battery in the pad: right-click the pad with it, right-click with an empty hand to take it back. Chargers of other mods work too.
codex.projectrebirth.body_charge.p8: In the HUD, above the integrity bar: thin bars of heat, charge and wear, each with its mark, and the numbers in the panel. Marks right of the integrity bar warn: no charge, overheating, critical wear, interference.
codex.projectrebirth.power_armor.p1: A walking suit of armor for a human or a body inside it.
codex.projectrebirth.power_armor.p2: Assembled in the heavy dock (see the Garrison tab).
codex.projectrebirth.power_armor.p3:
Place it from its item. Right-click to climb in, Shift to get out; the combat armor opens first: the chest plate swings down, the visor lifts. The pilot is protected: all damage goes to the armor.

Armor strikes with both hands for more damage, reaches farther and jumps higher; items in its fists keep their poses — bow, crossbow, trident, shield.
codex.projectrebirth.power_armor.p4: In armor the 9th hotbar slot becomes the ability slot; what was in it comes back when you get out.
codex.projectrebirth.integrity.p1:
Armor has two bars. Structural integrity takes ordinary hits and comes back by itself after a while. Critical integrity is worn by explosions and fire.

At zero structural integrity the armor shuts down. At zero critical it becomes a wreck that can only be taken apart.
codex.projectrebirth.integrity.p2: The repair wrench mends structural integrity in the field with iron. Shift with the wrench packs the armor into its item.
codex.projectrebirth.integrity.p4: Critical integrity is mended only at the maintenance station, with armor plates.
codex.projectrebirth.emergency.p1: A shut-down armor holds its pilot. Hold V inside to blow the hatch and climb out.
codex.projectrebirth.emergency.p2: The rescue tool pulls a pilot out of armor from outside.
codex.projectrebirth.variants.p1:
Combat armor: structural 100, critical 50, the strongest blows; with the ability slot chosen it hits harder.

Mobile armor: 70 and 35, faster, jumps higher and falls up to 15 blocks without harm; with the slot chosen it runs faster.

Worker armor: 60 and 30, mines like a diamond tool; B switches between 3×3 and one block; with the slot chosen it mines.
codex.projectrebirth.variants.p2: Mobile armor, in the heavy dock.
codex.projectrebirth.variants.p3: Worker armor, in the heavy dock.
codex.projectrebirth.armor_upgrades.p1: With the mounting tool, Shift + right-click your own empty armor: a window with 7 slots of hull parts opens. Putting an upgrade into a slot installs it, taking it out removes it. A banner goes on the back.
codex.projectrebirth.armor_upgrades.p3: Plating per part: copper +10, iron +20, titanium +30 structural (+5 critical). Compressed air: higher jump, safer fall. Floodlight (N): light where you look.
codex.projectrebirth.weapons.p1: Guns fire only from working power armor: left click fires, right click aims, R reloads. Without armor a gun can be carried, but it is a heavy load and does not fire. Each gun has its own rounds, made at the weapon workshop.
codex.projectrebirth.weapons.p2: Assault rifle: automatic, 30 rounds, 6 damage a bullet, 64 blocks.
codex.projectrebirth.weapons.p5: Battle rifle: one shot at a time with a scope, 10 rounds, 18 damage, 128 blocks.
codex.projectrebirth.weapons.p8: Combat shotgun: 6 shells, 8 pellets of 4 damage, 24 blocks; reloaded a shell at a time.
codex.projectrebirth.factions.p1:
A faction is a group of players who share a name, a color and land. Press G to open the faction window: create a faction, pick its color, invite players and answer invitations.

Members carry the tag "[Faction] Name" above the head, in chat and in the player list.
codex.projectrebirth.factions.p2: Friendly fire between members and allies is off by default. The leader turns it on in the window, if the server allows it.
codex.projectrebirth.faction_roles.p1:
Leader: everything — color, friendly fire, alliances and wars, any role below leader; may hand leadership over.

Officer: invites, places the core, removes members and recruits, moves people between member and recruit.

Member: uses chests, stations and capsules on the faction land.

Recruit: only doors there.
codex.projectrebirth.faction_territory.p: The core guards a square of 24 blocks each way, full height.

A leader or an officer places the core; a faction has one, and its square may not touch another faction's. There strangers do not open chests, stations or doors; allies use only doors.

The faction may break its own core at any time; the land goes with it.
codex.projectrebirth.faction_diplomacy.p:
Leaders make an alliance when both agree. Allies do not hurt each other while friendly fire is off and may use each other's doors.

A leader may declare war. For 10 minutes it is only preparation; then, while someone of the defenders is online, the enemy may open their doors and break their core.
Peace is made when both leaders agree. A war ends by itself after 72 hours.
codex.projectrebirth.hostile_world.p1:
The air of the world is polluted and radiation is everywhere. An unprotected person slowly gathers a toxic load and a radiation dose: hours in calm weather, minutes in a catastrophe. The body clears both by itself, slowly.

A roof helps a little (a quarter less pollution). Full protection without gear is only a sealed shelter.
codex.projectrebirth.hostile_world.p2:
Toxins (of 100): from 30 nausea, from 60 weakness, from 90 damage.

Dose (of 500): from 50 weakness, from 100 slower healing, from 200 less health, from 300 damage.

After death both start from zero.
codex.projectrebirth.hostile_world.p3: The HUD shows the toxins, the filter and the hazards around you; the dose — only with a dosimeter.
codex.projectrebirth.catastrophes.p1:
Catastrophes come by themselves, the first one no sooner than 40 minutes into a new world. Two minutes before, a message, a siren and a HUD line warn you.

Acid rain: real rain; toxins and damage in the open, it wears gear and bodies without a sealing module.
codex.projectrebirth.catastrophes.p2:
Toxic storm: a thick yellow-green fog, toxins come fast; a respirator and a roof help.

Radiation burst: the world turns brownish and grainy, more so the stronger it is, and the dose comes fast. A roof does not save you; a heavy suit and armor do, and in a shelter it is half as strong.
codex.projectrebirth.catastrophes.p3: A weather station sees a catastrophe coming earlier than the warning: ten minutes ahead roughly, thirty minutes ahead exactly with its long range module, and gives a redstone signal before it comes.
codex.projectrebirth.catastrophes.p4: A radiation burst and a toxic storm leave residual spots in the world, see Contaminated Zones.
Since 1.6 a radiation burst and a toxic storm leave spots behind: when the catastrophe fades, several spots of residual radiation or toxins appear in the world, near the players, 1 to 3 chunks wide, strongest in the middle. Toxic spots like swamps, rivers and lowlands.

Inside a spot the air is dirtier and the radiation higher, just like in a catastrophe: a respirator, a suit and a sealed shelter protect as usual. A body or an armor does not fall ill, but gathers contamination on itself and carries it home.

A spot fades by itself: radiation in a few days, toxins in a day or two.
The HUD line Contaminated zone tells you are in one; the dosimeter shows the radiation. Inside you see rare particles and a light tint of the air. Spots do not land on the lands of factions.
codex.projectrebirth.dust_storm.p1: Since 1.5 a dust storm comes too: thick brown fog, about eight blocks of view, sand in the wind. It is strongest in deserts and badlands, weaker in forests and swamps. A roof weakens it; deep ground and a sealed shelter keep it out.
codex.projectrebirth.dust_storm.p2:
Without a respirator a person is slowed down, coughs now and then and gathers a little toxin. A respirator keeps the dust out, but its filter clogs three times as fast.

A body without a sealing module wears and heats up. Solar panels give a quarter of their energy.
codex.projectrebirth.dust_storm.p3: The pilot of a power armor is safe. A body with a sealing module does not notice the dust.
codex.projectrebirth.protection.p1: The respirator keeps out polluted air while its filter lasts.
codex.projectrebirth.protection.p3: A filter is used only in dirty air. Right-click puts it in.
codex.projectrebirth.protection.p4:
The hazmat suit guards against toxins and acid, the heavy suit against radiation too. Protection is counted by the parts you wear: the helmet of a suit takes a filter like a respirator.

Trousers and boots are made the same way as the parts below.
codex.projectrebirth.emi_storm.p1: Since 1.5 an electromagnetic storm comes too: a glow in the sky that glides from violet to green and back. People hardly feel it, but electronics do. Deep ground weakens it; only a sealed shelter keeps it out.
codex.projectrebirth.emi_storm.p2:
A body: its HUD flickers, the jetpack cuts out, self-repair stops, charge runs out faster, and now and then a short fault slows it down and wears it a little. Control stays. Better bodies resist more.

Armor: its HUD flickers, the floodlight blinks, the aim shakes.
codex.projectrebirth.emi_storm.p3: Stations outside a sealed shelter stop while the storm lasts and go on afterwards; generators, batteries, cables and life support work on.
codex.projectrebirth.emi_storm.p4: Electronics shielding: a gadget that keeps 90% of the interference off a body.
codex.projectrebirth.emi_storm.p6: EMI screen: an armor upgrade for the chest, front or back; 90% less interference.
codex.projectrebirth.temperature.p1: Since 1.5 places have a temperature: deserts, badlands and the Nether are hot, snowy lands and high mountains cold; nights, rain and height make it colder, a roof or deep ground evens it out, and fire, lava and furnaces warm it. A sealed shelter keeps 20°C.
codex.projectrebirth.temperature.p2:
Between 5 and 30°C you are comfortable. Outside, heat or cold stress grows; in comfort it goes away.

From 30 weakness, from 60 slower healing, from 90 damage, and wounds no longer heal. Heat makes you hungry faster, cold slower.
codex.projectrebirth.temperature.p3: Artificial bodies do not feel cold; heat goes into their overheating. The pilot of a power armor is protected.
codex.projectrebirth.temperature.p4: In the HUD the line Temperature fills from the middle: to the right in heat, to the left in cold; a sun or a snowflake shows the stage.
codex.projectrebirth.thermal_gear.p1:
The heavy suit keeps off most heat and cold, the hazmat suit a little. Each piece counts by its share.

A thermal liner sewn into any piece — a suit or ordinary armor — keeps off 70% for that piece.
codex.projectrebirth.thermal_gear.p2: Put a piece and a liner on the crafting table. A lined piece alone gives the liner back.
codex.projectrebirth.thermal_gear.p4: Warms everything within 6 blocks by 20°C while it is cold around.
codex.projectrebirth.thermal_gear.p5: It runs on energy from the cable.
codex.projectrebirth.radiation_sources.p: Radioactive debris: radiation up to 10 blocks around, strongest next to it (8 units), weaker with distance.
A leaking waste barrel pollutes the air up to 7 blocks around (5 units next to it) and drips.

Sources add to the background where you stand, so the dosimeter, the HUD, the contamination on you, bodies and armor all count them. Each full solid block between you and a source halves it: a wall, rock or the wall of a shelter is a good shield.

They are found in abandoned places and cannot be carried away whole: broken, debris gives cobbled deepslate and now and then raw uranium, a barrel some iron nuggets, sludge nothing. Breaking one is the way to clear the place.
codex.projectrebirth.uranium.p1: Uranium ore lies rarely and deep, from y −64 to −16, in small veins, in stone and in deepslate. It needs an iron pickaxe and radiates a little around itself (up to 3 blocks).
codex.projectrebirth.uranium.p2: A furnace or a blast furnace makes an ingot of the ore or of the raw uranium.
codex.projectrebirth.uranium.p4: Raw uranium and ingots radiate in the inventory: 0.03 units for each item, up to 4. A hazmat or heavy suit lessens it as it lessens any radiation. Keep the stock in chests.
codex.projectrebirth.ruins.p1:
Old buildings stand in newly explored land. The richer the place, the more dangerous it is.

An abandoned laboratory (small, in forests, plains and swamps) keeps electronics, filters and medicine among leaking waste barrels.

Industrial ruins (medium, in open land) keep metals, parts, upgrades and now and then a packed worn body, near radioactive debris.

A ruined reactor (large and rare) has a core heaped with radioactive debris; the strongest technology lies there: processors, titanium, uranium, modules, worn bodies and wrecked power armor.
codex.projectrebirth.ruins.p2: Found bodies and armor are badly damaged: repair them before use. /locate structure projectrebirth:abandoned_lab (industrial_ruins, ruined_reactor) finds the nearest one.
codex.projectrebirth.large_structures.p1:
Far from home stand whole compounds of the old world. They are rarer than the small ruins and richer.

A military base: walls, towers with dead turrets, a headquarters of three floors and a garage of wrecked power armors. Ammunition, plates, sometimes a weapon.

A science complex: a hall of specimen tanks, a server room and an observatory under a dome. Electronics, medicine, synthetic bodies.

An abandoned factory: a smelting hall with glowing slag, presses and two smoking chimneys. Metals, parts, a worker armor now and then.
codex.projectrebirth.large_structures.p2:
A communication station: a lattice mast with red lamps and dishes, a room with a wall of screens. Electronics and batteries.

A defensive outpost: walls, two towers with searchlights, barracks and an armory.

A contamination zone: an ancient arch over pools of irradiated sludge. Each block of sludge radiates a little, and a pool adds them all up: come in protection. The richest loot here lies by a wrecked armor of an expedition that never came back.
codex.projectrebirth.large_structures.p3: A wrecked power armor cannot be repaired, but a wrench with sneaking takes it apart for iron and armor plates. Broken, a monitor gives a circuit board, a rack boards, iron and cable, a tank glass, an ammo crate ammunition; with silk touch they come away whole for your own base, and a lamp always does. Most screens, racks and tanks in the ruins are broken and most machines rusted through: only about one machine in five still works; the rest give scrap. /locate structure projectrebirth:military_base (science_complex, abandoned_factory, comm_station, defensive_outpost, contamination_zone).
codex.projectrebirth.guard_turret.p1:
Some turrets of the military base, the outpost and the communication station still work. A working turret sweeps its sector; when it sees you within about 20 blocks it beeps, takes a second to aim, then fires bursts of three. Its bullets hit like a rifle: armor and a power armor take them.

It sees only in a straight line: a wall, a corner or a hill hides you. It does not move and does not chase. Destroyed, it is left as a broken turret and drops scrap, ammunition and sometimes a board or an actuator.
codex.projectrebirth.guard_turret.p2: Approach from cover, or from behind where its head has to turn. Switched off in the config ([hostile]), the turrets stand broken.
codex.projectrebirth.patrol_robot.p1:
Two-metre walkers guard the military base, the outpost, the factory, the communication station and the industrial ruins. Each keeps to its post and walks round it; when it sees you within about 16 blocks it comes closer and fires short bursts from the gun of its right arm. Come up close and it swings its heavy left fist.

Destroyed, it leaves its wreck where it stood, like a broken power armor: take it apart with the repair wrench while sneaking for iron, boards, actuators and cable.
codex.projectrebirth.patrol_robot.p2: A wall breaks its line of fire, as with the turrets. The machines of the ruins do not hurt each other. Settings in the config ([hostile.patrol_robot]).
codex.projectrebirth.mech.p1:
One heavy walker, about three and a half blocks tall, guards the yard of each military base; its health bar shows while you are near. A twin machine gun under its right arm fires long bursts. Now and then the rocket pod on its left shoulder marks the ground under you with a red ring and an alarm: a moment later the rockets fall there, so do not stay in the ring. Come up close and it stomps, throwing everyone back.

At half its health it kneels and sheds its chest plate and rocket pod (it takes no damage meanwhile). Then it fights stripped, its glowing core bare: a gatling rises from behind its back and sprays long bursts; it charges straight at you and stomps more often, and on the jetpack on its back it takes off, circles over you firing and comes down with a shock. There is no hiding on a roof from it. No more rockets.
codex.projectrebirth.mech.p2: Destroyed, it leaves its wreck: the repair wrench while sneaking takes it apart for a lot of metal, titanium, boards, actuators, processors and power cells. The rockets do not break blocks unless the config says so ([hostile.mech]).
codex.projectrebirth.mutants.p1: Where a catastrophe left its contamination, in the contamination zone and in the laboratories and the reactor, mutants live. Mutated hounds are skinned, fast and come only in packs of three to five: when one sees you, the whole pack runs at you. The glowing ghoul, a worker in the rags of a hazmat suit, is slow, but spits toxic slime from afar; standing near it gives you radiation and toxins, and when it dies it leaves a toxic puddle that dries up after a few minutes.
codex.projectrebirth.mutants.p2: The brute is rare and very strong. Its blow throws you into the air. From a distance it roars and charges straight at you (dodge aside: a wall it runs into stuns it for a moment), or leaps onto you and lands with a shock. Its body stays after death, lying face down, and radiates until it rots away and sinks into the ground.
codex.projectrebirth.mutants.p3: Mutants do not burn in the sun and do not come in peaceful. Settings in the config ([hostile.mutants]).
codex.projectrebirth.polluted_water.p1:
Water is polluted where the ground is contaminated (a contaminated zone on the HUD), and during a toxic storm or acid rain wherever it lies under the open sky. It looks like any water. Swimming in it gives a person toxins (less in a protective suit) and soils whoever swims, so a decontamination is due afterwards.

A glass bottle or a bucket filled there holds polluted water. Drunk, a bottle of it gives toxins; it is no potion, so neither the brewing stand nor any recipe takes it. Poured from the bucket, it is just water again.
codex.projectrebirth.polluted_water.p2: The water purifier cleans it: polluted water in, a filter cartridge of the air filtration unit, clean water out (a bottle into a water bottle, a bucket into a water bucket). It needs energy; each bottle wears the cartridge a little (fifty bottles a cartridge), a used one turns spent. Hoppers bring water and cartridges and take the clean water away.
codex.projectrebirth.weather_station.p1: The weather station foresees the next catastrophe of its dimension, earlier than the usual warning: ten minutes ahead it knows the kind and the time within five minutes. It needs energy and the open sky right above it. Its window shows the forecast, the sky now and the last catastrophes.
codex.projectrebirth.weather_station.p2:
Whoever placed the station, the members of their faction (anywhere in the dimension) and every player within 64 blocks of it see the forecast in the HUD, in place of the line of the warning.

The station gives a redstone signal five minutes before a catastrophe it foresees and while one goes on: close the airlock, start the reserve. A comparator reads how close the catastrophe is (stronger as it comes nearer, 15 during it).
codex.projectrebirth.weather_station.p4: The long range forecast module, put into the station, sees thirty minutes ahead and tells the exact time, the intensity and the length of the catastrophe. It takes more energy.
The environmental monitoring station scans the contamination of the ground around it, eight chunks each way, every few seconds, as long as it has energy. Its window shows a map of the chunks: radiation yellow, toxins green, the brighter the stronger; the station, the shelters (air filtration units) and the players are marked. Point at a chunk for its numbers. Below, a graph of the peaks of the last game days.

Put paper in and press Print: the station prints the scan as a contamination map for an expedition. Used from the hand, the map shows the picture of the day it was printed; it does not change. A comparator next to the station reads the strongest contamination close to it.
codex.projectrebirth.field_scouting.p1: The field analyzer, held in either hand, shows under the status panel how much radiation and toxins the ground of your chunk holds and what the sources around you (radioactive blocks, uranium ore, creatures) give, with a small map of the chunks around. Near a source it clicks, the faster the stronger.
codex.projectrebirth.field_scouting.p3: The sensor module is a gadget of artificial bodies: the body shows a map of the contamination around, with the source blocks (violet crosses) and the ruins of the mod (brown squares) marked. Its reach grows with the class of the body: from two chunks each way for the basic robot to six for the premium body.
codex.projectrebirth.field_scouting.p5: The sensor unit does the same for the pilot of power armor; it goes on the helmet and reaches five chunks each way.
codex.projectrebirth.dosimeter.p1: Carried, it shows your dose and the radiation, and clicks.
codex.projectrebirth.dosimeter.p3: Nobody feels radiation. Without a dosimeter the HUD does not show the dose at all.
codex.projectrebirth.dosimeter.p4: The dosimeter tells what reaches you. Where it comes from, the field analyzer tells: held in hand, it shows the contamination of the ground and of the sources around you (see Scouting in the Field).
codex.projectrebirth.medicine.p1: Antiradin: drink it to lose 80 of the dose.
codex.projectrebirth.medicine.p3: Sorbent: drink it to lose 50 of the toxic load.
codex.projectrebirth.machines_environmen:
Artificial bodies do not get sick, but without a sealing module acid adds wear (since 1.5, not damage); better bodies wear slower.

A power armor pilot is safe from toxins and acid, and only a fifth of the radiation reaches them. Plating adds more protection.
In a catastrophe, contamination settles on bodies and armor too. Wash it off before you go into the shelter.
codex.projectrebirth.sealed_room.p1:
A sealed room is the only place where a person is fully safe without gear: its own air, half the radiation, no acid.

The air filtration unit placed inside finds the room by itself: up to 4096 blocks of air per unit, up to 8 units in one room.
codex.projectrebirth.sealed_room.p2: It needs energy and a filter cartridge.
codex.projectrebirth.sealed_room.p4: Walls are blocks that close a whole face: full blocks, glass, slabs and stairs by their whole side. Leaves, fences, panes and open sky leak.
codex.projectrebirth.sealed_room.p5: The mod's energy cable may go through a wall: the room stays sealed.
codex.projectrebirth.shelter_doors.p1: The airlock door holds the air when closed.
codex.projectrebirth.shelter_doors.p3: The sealed hatch is the same for floors and ceilings.
codex.projectrebirth.shelter_doors.p4:
Iron and copper doors and trapdoors leak a little; wooden ones do not hold the air at all.

Two airlock doors with a small room between them (up to 64 blocks) make an airlock: they never open at the same time.
codex.projectrebirth.filter_cartridges.p: The cartridge cleans the air; the dirtier, the faster it wears.
A spent cartridge is refilled at the assembly station.

The unit takes energy through the cable: 4 FE a tick and 10 more per 1000 blocks of its room. Its window shows the room, the air, the energy and the cartridge. Hoppers bring new cartridges and take the spent ones.
codex.projectrebirth.decontamination.p1: In a catastrophe, external contamination settles on people, their gear, bodies and armor. What is not washed off is brought into the air of the shelter.
codex.projectrebirth.decontamination.p2: Step in: the chamber washes you in a few seconds.
codex.projectrebirth.decontamination.p4: Right-click the chamber with it, or use hoppers.
codex.projectrebirth.decontamination.p5: Armor and bodies are too large to step in: they are washed standing right in front of the chamber.
codex.projectrebirth.radiation_purge.p1: Stand on it to lose the dose slowly.
codex.projectrebirth.radiation_purge.p3: The station works only in a sealed room with clean air and uses 80 FE a tick. It is a late machine: titanium, processors and power cells.
codex.projectrebirth.backup_battery.p1: It feeds only life support, and only when needed.
codex.projectrebirth.backup_battery.p3: Life support is the air filtration unit and the decontamination chamber. The cable feeds them first, and when that is not enough the backup steps in.
codex.projectrebirth.shelter_panel.p1: It shows the rooms and the reserve, and finds a leak.
codex.projectrebirth.shelter_panel.p3:
The panel gives a redstone signal by the danger: 0 all is well … 15 a leak. When a leak or a lack of energy lasts 10 seconds, the owner and their faction are warned; so too about cartridges and the reserve.

The HUD shows a "Shelter" line and the contamination on you.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p1:
A multiblock is a machine built of many blocks around a controller. Build the frame by its plan: the controller checks it itself whenever a block inside it changes. Until the frame is whole, the work stands still and loses nothing.

Right-click the controller with the repair wrench or this Codex: a hologram shows the missing blocks in place, wrong ones in a red frame. Click again to hide it.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p2:
The controller window holds the item the assembly starts from, the materials and the result. An assembly goes in stages (frame, actuators, electronics, plating, calibration): the materials of a stage are taken when it begins, its time runs while there is energy.

The controller itself takes no energy: it comes through an energy port. A cargo port lets hoppers and pipes bring materials in and take the result out.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p3: The energy port: FE from cables of this mod and others.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p4: The cargo port: items in and out.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p5: Assembly plates: the floor of every workshop.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p6: Assembly frames: the walls and roof of the body workshop.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p7: Heavy frames: the walls of the heavy dock.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p8: Crane beams: the roof of the heavy dock.
codex.projectrebirth.multiblocks.p9: Manipulators are robot arms with a telescopic forearm. While the assembly goes, each reaches the machine with its tool: the welder runs its torch over it in sparks, the gripper brings the parts of the current stage and sets them in place, the screwdriver drives screws into it. Any kind fits any manipulator place of a plan; mix them as you like.
codex.projectrebirth.body_workshop.p1:
The body workshop is 3×3 and 4 high. A body grows in its middle part by part as the stages go.

Synthetic bodies (advanced, high-tech, premium) are assembled only here, each from the body before it. Robot bodies can be made here cheaper than at the assembly station. Upgrades of the old body go over to the new one.
codex.projectrebirth.body_workshop.p2: Plates, frames, two manipulators; the controller in front, both ports at the back.
codex.projectrebirth.body_workshop.p3: The controller: at the electronics fabricator.
codex.projectrebirth.heavy_dock.p1:
The heavy dock is 7×7 and 7 high, with a gate 5×5 in front. Power armor of all three kinds is assembled here from a power frame, heavy actuators, a processor, power cells and a hull of its kind. A finished armor does not go into the window: it rolls out through the gate by itself and stands in front of the dock, ready to climb in. So does all else the dock builds: the guard mech rolls out charged and ready, a turret in a crate (right-click the crate to take the turret).

The armor workstation makes the power frame and the hulls; the assembly station makes heavy actuators.
codex.projectrebirth.heavy_dock.p2: Heavy frames, crane beams on top, four manipulators; the controller left of the gate.
codex.projectrebirth.heavy_dock.p3: The controller: at the armor workstation.
codex.projectrebirth.heavy_dock.p12: With multiblocks turned off in the server settings, the old station recipes of synthetic bodies and power armor come back.
codex.projectrebirth.ai_core.p1: The AI core is the mind of every machine of yours: an android, a turret, the mech. One core, one machine. It does not stack, and it serves the first player who carries it: the one who made or restored it, and their faction at that moment.
codex.projectrebirth.ai_core.p2: The neural matrix, at the electronics fabricator: processors, silver, quartz, an echo shard and uranium.
codex.projectrebirth.ai_core.p3: The core itself, at the assembly station.
codex.projectrebirth.ai_core.p4: The cheaper way is riskier: the wrecks of the patrol robots and of the mech in the ruins sometimes give a damaged AI core when taken apart with the wrench (the mech always). The electronics fabricator restores it, and the restored core serves whoever takes it.
codex.projectrebirth.ai_core.p6: The combat module: guarding, patrols, fighting.
codex.projectrebirth.ai_core.p7: The work module: mining, cutting wood, farming.
codex.projectrebirth.machine_integrity.p:
Every machine has two bars, like power armor. Structural integrity takes any damage and comes back by itself after a pause; critical integrity is lost to explosions and fire, and to any damage once structural is gone.

No structural integrity: the machine shuts down: the mech and the small robot sink onto their knees, an android kneels, a turret lets its head hang. No critical: it becomes a wreck, dark with soot and rust, slumped in a heap.

The repair wrench mends structural integrity with iron and starts a shut-down machine again. With Shift it packs a machine into its item: only the owner, or a leader or officer of the owner's faction. A service post mends structural integrity too, with iron or armor plates from its chest. Critical integrity and wear are mended only at the maintenance station: plates, iron and actuators.

Armor plating installed on a turret or the mech keeps a share of the damage off: copper 10 %, iron 20 %, titanium 30 %.

Anyone can take a wreck apart with the wrench and Shift: parts, its upgrades and a damaged AI core. Machines cannot be stolen: a stranger can only destroy one.

Acid rain and dust wear machines outside; an electromagnetic storm disturbs them outside a shelter unless an EMI screen is installed.
Limits: per player 6 androids, 10 turrets, 8 small robots; per faction 12, 20 and 16. Mechs have no limit of their own beyond the server-wide machine limit (200). All of these are server settings.
codex.projectrebirth.target_rules.p1:
Machines decide whom to attack by the rules of the factions.

Never: you, your faction, your allies, players in creative mode, peaceful creatures.
Always: monsters, mutants and the machines of the ruins.
Neutral creatures and other players: only if they attacked the machine, its owner or a member of its faction nearby.
codex.projectrebirth.target_rules.p2:
In an active war, machines fight the players and machines of the enemy faction, but not on the enemy's land while none of them is online: the protection of territories holds for machines too.

The intruder mode (a switch on the console, off by default; the server may forbid it) attacks any outsider on your faction's land, in peace too, while the machine stands on that land.
codex.projectrebirth.console.p1:
The command console is the post of your machines. It runs on energy from a cable. A machine set up within 32 blocks of your console answers to it by itself; others are linked with the tactical tablet. One console commands up to 64 machines within 256 blocks, in its own dimension.

Machines far from players stand still, as everything does: the console shows them as they were last heard.
codex.projectrebirth.console.p3:
Machines: the list, the chosen machine, its group (up to eight groups) and the orders: guard a point, patrol a route, sweep an area, follow you, hold where it stands, work (miner, lumberjack, farmer), go to the post, take cover, stand down. Orders with points (guard, patrol, work) need a tablet linked to the console: the window closes and you mark the points in the world, as with the tablet.

Sweeping an area needs no points: the chosen machines spread out round their middle (50 blocks by default), each in its own sector, and walk it from place to place without a route. They attack enemies in that area and go back to their sector after a fight. Turrets stay where they are.

Map: the machines around the console; a monitoring station near it adds the contamination under them.
codex.projectrebirth.console.p4:
Rules: the intruder mode for the whole console and for each group (attack any outsider on your faction's land, in peace too; the server may forbid it), and the weather link: before a catastrophe a weather station near foresees, every machine takes cover.

Log: the alarms. Intruder, fight, machine shut down, machine lost, no energy or ammunition: each is told to you and your faction once when it starts and once when it ends.
codex.projectrebirth.console.p5: Redstone: the console gives a signal by the worst alarm (intruder 15, fight 12, lost 9, shut down 6, no supply 3); a comparator reads the share of the machines in working order.
codex.projectrebirth.tactical_tablet.p1:
The console's orders in the field, within 256 blocks of the console. Right-click a console to link the tablet; right-click a machine to put it under that console.

Right-click in the air opens the tablet: the console's machines, then whom the order is for (a machine from the list, a group or All), then the order. Hover over an order to read what it does.
codex.projectrebirth.tactical_tablet.p2:
Orders with points close the screen; mark them in the world with right-clicks, and the order goes out by itself:
• Guard: the block to guard.
• Patrol: the route points one by one (two to 16), then right-click the air to send.
• Work (dig, chop, farm, ore): two opposite corners of the area, then the chest.
While you mark, the HUD says the next step; right-click the air cancels. The points of the last orders stay drawn while the tablet is in hand.

A work area is at most 16 blocks each side and 64 deep for a miner, 32 for a lumberjack and a farmer.
codex.projectrebirth.tactical_tablet.p3: If an order seems not to work: the console must have energy, and the machine must be within the console's range; the tablet's list marks a machine out of reach with ⚠, and the order waits for it. A mech also needs charge: it charges at a service post.
codex.projectrebirth.androids.p1:
An android is an artificial body run by an AI core instead of a mind. It is a machine of the core's owner: it obeys the console and the tactical tablet, keeps the rules of targets and counts toward the limits of machines.

Nobody can move into a body that has an AI core: the capsule does not list it.
codex.projectrebirth.androids.p2:
Assembly, in the body workshop: a packed body of any class, an AI core and a module: the combat module or the work module. The body keeps its upgrades, charge and wear.

The reverse recipe takes the core out: the body, the core and the module come back whole.
codex.projectrebirth.androids.p5: Integrity: the structural bar is the body's own integrity; the critical bar is half of it. The repair wrench mends the structural bar with iron. At the maintenance station a packed android takes the body's materials (iron or synthetic fiber, actuators or circuit boards) and armor plates for the critical bar.
codex.projectrebirth.combat_android.p1: A combat android: the visor and the core antenna glow in the colour of its faction.
codex.projectrebirth.combat_android.p2:
Right-click the android to open its gear: 36 slots (the first is the hand), armor and the off hand. Sneak + right-click packs it up; its gear falls out where it stood.

It fights with what it holds: a sword, an axe, a trident; a bow or a crossbow with arrows from its gear. A shield in the off hand blocks. Armor works as on a player. It never uses the guns of power armor.
codex.projectrebirth.combat_android.p3:
The gadgets of the body work: the jetpack lifts it over obstacles, plates and sealing protect it.

The better the body, the better the fighter: from the basic robot to the premium synthetic body the android is faster, reacts sooner, shoots more accurately and sees farther (16 to 32 blocks).
codex.projectrebirth.combat_android.p4:
Orders from the console: guard a point, patrol a route, sweep an area, escort you, hold its place, go to the post, take cover.

Charge: when it runs low, the android walks to the nearest charging pad (within 256 blocks) or service post, whichever is nearer, and waits there. With no charge left it stops in emergency mode, its visor blinks red and the console raises the alarm "no supply".
codex.projectrebirth.work_android.p1:
A work android is an android with the work module: it mines, fells trees or farms. The work is chosen at the console and changes without taking the android apart.

Choose the work on the tactical tablet (dig, chop, farm, ore), then right-click two corners of the area and the chest it hands in at. It works as fast as you would with the same tool, times the work speed of its body class.
codex.projectrebirth.work_android.p3:
What it gets goes into its gear. When the gear is full, or the work is done, it carries it to the chest and keeps a few seeds, saplings or plugging blocks. Low on charge it goes to a charging pad and then goes on.

It never breaks containers, the machines of the mod, capsules, shelter doors and hatches, the faction core, nor anything on land its owner may not use. Attacked, it runs to its chest and the console hears of the fight. It does not fight.
codex.projectrebirth.work_android.p4:
Miner: up to 16 by 16 blocks and 64 deep. It takes the area layer by layer from the top and leaves a spiral stair along the wall to climb out. It needs a pickaxe in hand; when it breaks, the android takes a new one from the chest or reports "no tool". Water and lava are plugged with cobblestone or other stone from its gear, or skipped.

The work "miner: ores only" mines the whole area too, but keeps only ores and the valuable blocks of the config: the stone stays behind as nothing.
codex.projectrebirth.work_android.p5: Lumberjack: up to 32 by 32 blocks. It fells whole trees from the bottom, branches and big 2 by 2 trees too, and cuts their leaves. A log counts as a tree only with natural leaves near it, so it leaves your buildings alone. It picks up logs, saplings, apples and sticks and plants a sapling where the tree stood. An axe in hand makes it faster; without one it fells by hand.
codex.projectrebirth.work_android.p6: Farmer: up to 32 by 32 blocks. It harvests only what is ripe: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, nether wart, cocoa, sweet berries, melons and pumpkins (the stem stays), sugar cane and bamboo (the lowest block stays). It replants from what it gathered and sows empty farmland. It does not till new land nor touch animals, and never tramples the fields.
codex.projectrebirth.work_android.p7: Its reports at the console: the work is done or there is nothing to do (in the log only), no tool, the chest is full or out of reach, no charge, attacked.
codex.projectrebirth.defence_turrets.p1: The machine gun turret: the guard turret of the ruins in service paint, with stripes in the colour of its faction.
codex.projectrebirth.defence_turrets.p2:
Your own guard turrets. A turret stands on a turret mount: cables bring the mount energy, hoppers or your hand bring it ammunition. Each shot takes its energy and one round or rocket from the mount. Without them the turret is silent and the console raises the alarm "no supply".

Right-click the mount to see what it holds.
codex.projectrebirth.defence_turrets.p4:
Assembly, in the heavy dock: armor plates and actuators, a weapon node, an AI core and circuit boards. The turret belongs to the owner of its core. It rolls out of the dock in a crate: right-click the crate to take it, then set it up by right-clicking the top of a mount.

The machine gun turret: 24 blocks, bursts of assault rifle rounds, integrity 80 / 40. It never hits its own.
codex.projectrebirth.defence_turrets.p6: The rocket turret: 6 to 32 blocks, a rocket along an arc against groups, mechs and brutes, integrity 100 / 50. Its blast breaks no blocks, and it holds fire while one of its own is near the target.
codex.projectrebirth.defence_turrets.p9:
A turret finds its target by the rules of targets and obeys the console: hold, stand down. Upgrades, two slots, with the upgrade mounting tool: armor plating (less damage), an EMI screen, a sensor unit (8 blocks more range), a stabilizer (half the spread).

A dust storm spreads its fire. An EMI storm outside a shelter throws its aim off and now and then shuts it down for a few seconds.
codex.projectrebirth.defence_turrets.p11: Integrity as for every machine: at no structural integrity it shuts down and its barrel hangs; the repair wrench with iron starts it again. At no critical integrity it is a wreck: Shift + the wrench takes it apart for plates, its upgrades and a damaged AI core.
codex.projectrebirth.guard_mech.p1: The guard mech: the mech of the ruins in service, with a stripe and a banner in the colour of its faction.
codex.projectrebirth.guard_mech.p2: The top of your garrison. Built in the heavy dock: a power frame and heavy actuators, a mech armor hull, two weapon nodes, an AI core with processors and power cells. It rolls out of the dock charged, ready for orders. Integrity 250 / 125, three upgrade slots (power armor upgrades). Nobody pilots it: for a pilot there is power armor. It has no second phase: it is a machine in service, not a boss.
codex.projectrebirth.guard_mech.p5:
Weapons: on each side a machine gun node or a rocket launcher node, in any mix. Right-click it with a node to put it on the right, with Shift on the left; the old node comes back to you.

It has its own energy and magazine. Right-click it with rounds or rockets to load them; with an empty hand it tells its energy and magazine. Rockets break no blocks and are not fired near its own.
codex.projectrebirth.guard_mech.p6:
Orders from the console as for androids. The mech is wide and heavy: it walks open ground and does not pass narrow doors. When you give it a patrol route, the console warns you of places too narrow for it.

Below a fifth of its energy it walks to the nearest service post and waits there until charged. Empty, it stops and the console raises the alarm "no supply", as it does when it has no ammunition left.
codex.projectrebirth.guard_mech.p7:
Close combat and the jetpack, as its prototype from the ruins has them.

Whoever comes up close is stomped: a foot brought down on the ground hurts and throws back every enemy near it. Its own, your allies and your faction's players are not touched.

The jetpack on its back lifts it into the air. Where it cannot get on foot — a high wall, a cliff, a dead end — the mech flies over. In a fight, when its target is higher than it reaches, or now and then, it rises over the target, circles it firing, then comes down with a stomp. Flight uses energy: low on charge, the mech does not take off. Between flights it needs a rest.
codex.projectrebirth.small_robot.p1: The small robot: a cheap soldier as tall as the patrol robot, about two blocks. In its right arm it has a rotary three-barrel machine gun, on its back a pack with a cooling fan, on its left arm a claw; across its chest a stripe in the colour of its faction.
codex.projectrebirth.small_robot.p2: The rank and file of your garrison. Built in the heavy dock, quickly and cheaply: iron and actuators, a machine gun node, an AI core with a circuit board and a power cell; no body is needed. It rolls out of the dock charged. Integrity 50 / 25, one upgrade slot (power armor upgrades); a player keeps up to 8 of them.
codex.projectrebirth.small_robot.p4:
Its machine gun is built in and fires assault rifle rounds: right-click it with rounds to load them (192 at most), with an empty hand to see its charge and magazine. A service post fills its magazine from the post's chest.

It takes the orders of the console and the tablet as the mech does, and goes through doors where the mech cannot. Low on charge it walks to the nearest service post or charging pad and waits there; empty, it stops and the console hears of it.
codex.projectrebirth.service_post.p1:
A station for your machines. Lay four post plates in a square of two by two, set the post console next to them, a chest next to the console, and bring the console energy by cable.

A machine standing on the plates is charged, its structural integrity mended with iron ingots or armor plates from the chest, and a mech's magazine filled with rounds and rockets from it. Critical integrity is not mended here: pack the machine and take it to the maintenance station.
codex.projectrebirth.service_post.p4:
The order "to the post" sends androids and mechs to the nearest post (or to their console when there is none). Machines also go by themselves: mechs and small robots when their energy or their rounds and rockets run low, androids when their charge is low, to a post or a charging pad, whichever is nearer. A post is looked for within 256 blocks; with none there the machine tells its console. A served machine with no order walks back where it came from and leaves the plates free. With no ammunition in the chest a machine waits 10 seconds and goes. Turrets need no post: their mount feeds them.

Machines walk round obstacles. A stuck machine jumps and steps aside; when it cannot get through for long its console raises the alarm "Machine stuck".

Right-click the post console to see its energy and the machines it serves.
